```diff
+   })
+ 
+   it(&#39;确认拖动时应删除影子线&#39;, () =&gt; {
+     const { result } = renderHook(() =&gt;
+       useEChartsDualStopLoss({
+         priceLineManager: mockPriceLineManager,
+       })
+     )
+ 
+     act(() =&gt; {
+       result.current.startDragStopLoss(mockStopLossLine, OrderSide.BUY)
+     })
+ 
+     act(() =&gt; {
+       result.current.updateDragStopLoss(24800)
+     })
+ 
+     const confirmedPrice = act(() =&gt; {
+       return result.current.confirmDragStopLoss()
+     })
+ 
+     expect(confirmedPrice).toBe(24800)
+     expect(result.current.isDraggingStopLoss).toBe(false)
+     expect(mockPriceLineManager.removeLine).toHaveBeenCalled()
+   })
+ 
+   it(&#39;取消拖动时应恢复原始价格并删除影子线&#39;, () =&gt; {
+     const { result } = renderHook(() =&gt;
+       useEChartsDualStopLoss({
+         priceLineManager: mockPriceLineManager,
+       })
+     )
+ 
+     act(() =&gt; {
+       result.current.startDragStopLoss(mockStopLossLine, OrderSide.BUY)
+     })
+ 
+     act(() =&gt; {
+       result.current.updateDragStopLoss(24800)
+     })
+ 
+     act(() =&gt; {
+       result.current.cancelDragStopLoss()
+     })
+ 
+     expect(result.current.isDraggingStopLoss).toBe(false)
+     expect(mockPriceLineManager.removeLine).toHaveBeenCalled()
+     expect(mockPriceLineManager.updateLine).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
+       &#39;sl-1&#39;,
+       expect.objectContaining({ price: 24900 })
+     )
+   })
+ })
+ 
+ describe(&#39;E7: useEChartsEntryLineDrag&#39;, () =&gt; {
+   let mockPriceLineManager: EChartsPriceLineManager
+   let orderService: OrderService
+   let mockChart: EChartsType
+ 
+   const mockEntryLine: ChartPriceLine = {
+     id: &#39;entry-1&#39;,
+     orderId: &#39;order1&#39;,
+     type: PriceLineType.ENTRY,
+     price: 25000,
+     color: &#39;#ff4757&#39;,
+     lineWidth: 2,
+     lineStyle: &#39;solid&#39;,
+     title: &#39;入场 @ 25000&#39;,
+     draggable: false,
+   }
+ 
+   // 模拟价格到像素的转换
+   const mockPriceToPixel = (price: number) =&gt; 500 - (price - 25000) * 0.1
+ 
+   beforeEach(() =&gt; {
+     orderService = new OrderService()
+     // 创建测试订单
+     orderService.createOrder({
+       side: OrderSide.BUY,
+       price: 25000,
+       quantity: 1,
+     })
+ 
+     mockPriceLineManager = {
+       getAllLines: vi.fn().mockReturnValue([mockEntryLine]),
+       createPriceLine: vi.fn((config) =&gt; ({ ...config })),
+       createStopLossLine: vi.fn((config) =&gt; ({ id: &#39;sl-new&#39;, ...config })),
+       createTakeProfitLine: vi.fn((config) =&gt; ({ id: &#39;tp-new&#39;, ...config })),
+       updateLine: vi.fn(),
+       removeLine: vi.fn().mockReturnValue(true),
+     } as unknown as EChartsPriceLineManager
+ 
+     mockChart = {
+       convertToPixel: vi.fn((coordSys, value) =&gt; [0, mockPriceToPixel(value[1])]),
+       convertFromPixel: vi.fn((coordSys, value) =&gt; {
+         const price = 25000 - (value[1] - 500) / 0.1
+         return [0, price]
+       }),
+     } as unknown as EChartsType
+   })
+ 
+   it(&#39;应该初始化为非创建状态&#39;, () =&gt; {
+     const { result } = renderHook(() =&gt;
+       useEChartsEntryLineDrag({
+         priceLineManager: mockPriceLineManager,
+         orderService,
+         chart: mockChart,
+       })
+     )
+ 
+     expect(result.current.isCreatingFromEntry).toBe(false)
+     expect(result.current.creatingLineType).toBeNull()
+   })
+ 
+   it(&#39;应该找到最近的入场线&#39;, () =&gt; {

+       useEChartsEntryLineDrag({

+         orderService,
+         chart: mockChart,
+       })

+ 
+     // pixelY = 500 对应 price = 25000
+     const nearestLine = result.current.findNearestEntryLine(502)

+     expect(nearestLine!.type).toBe(PriceLineType.ENTRY)
+   })
+ 
+   it(&#39;开始从入场线创建时应记录状态&#39;, () =&gt; {

+ 
+   it(&#39;买入订单向下拖拽应创建止损线&#39;, () =&gt; {

+

+ 
+     // 向下拖拽（pixelY增大 = 价格降低）足够距离
+     act(() =&gt; {

+     })
+ 
+     expect(result.current.creatingLineType).toBe(&#39;stop_loss&#39;)
+   })
+ 
+   it(&#39;买入订单向上拖拽应创建止盈线&#39;, () =&gt; {

+     mockEntryLine.orderId = orders[0].id
+

+         orderService,

+       })

+ 
+     act(() =&gt; {

+

+ 
+   it(&#39;拖拽距离不足时不应创建&#39;, () =&gt; {

+

+

+

+   })
+ 
+   it(&#39;取消创建时应删除预览线&#39;, () =&gt; {

+

+     })
+ 
+     expect(result.current.isCreatingFromEntry).toBe(false)
```

### 完成内容

### 新增文件

```
frontend/src/
├── hooks/
│   ├── useEChartsAutoTrailingStopLoss.ts   # 自动追踪止损
│   ├── useEChartsDualStopLoss.ts           # 双止损保护
│   └── useEChartsEntryLineDrag.ts          # 入场线拖拽创建
└── tests/
    └── useEChartsAdvancedFeatures.test.ts  # 17个单元测试
```

### E5: 自动追踪止损功能

| 功能 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| `calculateStopLossPrice()` | 根据入场价计算止损价 |
| `updateStopLossOnPendingDrag()` | 拖动挂单时自动更新止损 |
| `setAutoTrailingEnabled()` | 启用/禁用自动追踪 |

### E6: 双止损保护功能

| 功能 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| `startDragStopLoss()` | 开始拖动，创建影子线 |
| `updateDragStopLoss()` | 更新拖动，影子线滞后跟随 |
| `confirmDragStopLoss()` | 确认，删除影子线 |
| `cancelDragStopLoss()` | 取消，恢复原价格 |

### E7: 入场线拖拽创建

| 功能 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| `findNearestEntryLine()` | 查找最近入场线 |
| `startCreateFromEntry()` | 开始创建 |
| `updateCreateFromEntry()` | 根据方向判断止损/止盈 |

```diff
+ import { memo } from &#39;react&#39;
+ import { TradingOrder, OrderSide, OrderStatus } from &#39;../types&#39;
+ 
+ interface OrderListPanelProps {
+   orders: TradingOrder[]
+   onSimulateFill?: (orderId: string) =&gt; void

+   onClosePosition?: (orderId: string) =&gt; void

+ /**
+  * 订单列表面板

+ function OrderListPanel({

+   onSimulateFill,
+   onCancelOrder,
+   onClosePosition,

+   const pendingOrders = orders.filter(o =&gt; o.status === OrderStatus.PENDING)
+   const filledOrders = orders.filter(o =&gt; o.status === OrderStatus.FILLED)
```

```diff
+ import { memo } from &#39;react&#39;
+ 
+ type StatusType = &#39;drawing&#39; | &#39;dragging&#39; | &#39;creating&#39; | &#39;nearLine&#39; | &#39;dualStopLoss&#39;
+ 
+ interface StatusIndicatorProps {
+   type: StatusType
+   visible: boolean
+   // 画线模式提示
+   drawingPrice?: number
+   // 拖拽止损提示
+   draggingInfo?: {
+     originalPrice: number
+     currentPrice: number
+     shadowPrice?: number
+   }
+   // 创建止损/止盈提示
+   creatingInfo?: {
+     lineType: &#39;stop_loss&#39; | &#39;take_profit&#39;
+     entryPrice: number
+     currentPrice: number
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * 状态提示组件
+  * 显示各种操作状态的提示信息
+  */
+ function StatusIndicator({
+   type,
+   visible,
+   drawingPrice,
+   draggingInfo,
+   creatingInfo,
+ }: StatusIndicatorProps) {
+   if (!visible) return null
+ 
+   const getStatusContent = () =&gt; {
+     switch (type) {
+       case &#39;drawing&#39;:
+         return (
+           &lt;div&gt;
+             &lt;div style={{ fontWeight: &#39;600&#39;, marginBottom: &#39;4px&#39; }}&gt;画线下单模式&lt;/div&gt;
+             {drawingPrice !== undefined &amp;&amp; (
+               &lt;div style={{ fontSize: &#39;1.1rem&#39;, fontFamily: &#39;monospace&#39;, color: &#39;#90EE90&#39; }}&gt;
+                 {drawingPrice.toFixed(0)}
+               &lt;/div&gt;
+             )}
+             &lt;div style={{ fontSize: &#39;0.75rem&#39;, marginTop: &#39;4px&#39;, opacity: 0.8 }}&gt;
+               点击确认 | ESC取消
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+         )
+ 
+       case &#39;dragging&#39;:
+         return (
+           &lt;div&gt;
+             &lt;div style={{ fontWeight: &#39;600&#39;, marginBottom: &#39;4px&#39; }}&gt;拖拽移动中&lt;/div&gt;
+             {draggingInfo &amp;&amp; (
+               &lt;&gt;
+                 &lt;div style={{ display: &#39;flex&#39;, justifyContent: &#39;space-between&#39;, gap: &#39;12px&#39; }}&gt;
+                   &lt;span style={{ opacity: 0.8 }}&gt;原价:&lt;/span&gt;
+                   &lt;span style={{ fontFamily: &#39;monospace&#39; }}&gt;{draggingInfo.originalPrice.toFixed(0)}&lt;/span&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;div style={{ display: &#39;flex&#39;, justifyContent: &#39;space-between&#39;, gap: &#39;12px&#39; }}&gt;
+                   &lt;span style={{ opacity: 0.8 }}&gt;当前:&lt;/span&gt;
+                   &lt;span style={{ fontFamily: &#39;monospace&#39;, color: &#39;#90EE90&#39; }}&gt;
+                     {draggingInfo.currentPrice.toFixed(0)}
+                   &lt;/span&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+                 {draggingInfo.shadowPrice !== undefined &amp;&amp; (
+                   &lt;div style={{ display: &#39;flex&#39;, justifyContent: &#39;space-between&#39;, gap: &#39;12px&#39; }}&gt;
+                     &lt;span style={{ opacity: 0.8 }}&gt;保护:&lt;/span&gt;
+                     &lt;span style={{ fontFamily: &#39;monospace&#39;, color: &#39;#ffa502&#39; }}&gt;
+                       {draggingInfo.shadowPrice.toFixed(0)}
+                     &lt;/span&gt;
+                   &lt;/div&gt;
+                 )}
+               &lt;/&gt;
+             )}
+             &lt;div style={{ fontSize: &#39;0.75rem&#39;, marginTop: &#39;4px&#39;, opacity: 0.8 }}&gt;
+               释放确认 | ESC取消
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+         )
+ 
+       case &#39;creating&#39;:
+         return (
+           &lt;div&gt;
+             &lt;div style={{ fontWeight: &#39;600&#39;, marginBottom: &#39;4px&#39; }}&gt;
+               创建{creatingInfo?.lineType === &#39;stop_loss&#39; ? &#39;止损&#39; : &#39;止盈&#39;}线
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+             {creatingInfo &amp;&amp; (
+               &lt;&gt;
+                 &lt;div style={{ display: &#39;flex&#39;, justifyContent: &#39;space-between&#39;, gap: &#39;12px&#39; }}&gt;
+                   &lt;span style={{ opacity: 0.8 }}&gt;成本价:&lt;/span&gt;
+                   &lt;span style={{ fontFamily: &#39;monospace&#39; }}&gt;{creatingInfo.entryPrice.toFixed(0)}&lt;/span&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;

+                     {creatingInfo.lineType === &#39;stop_loss&#39; ? &#39;止损:&#39; : &#39;止盈:&#39;}
+                   &lt;/span&gt;
+                   &lt;span style={{ fontFamily: &#39;monospace&#39;, color: &#39;#90EE90&#39; }}&gt;
+                     {creatingInfo.currentPrice.toFixed(0)}

+

+         )
+ 
+       case &#39;dualStopLoss&#39;:
+         return (
+           &lt;div&gt;
+             &lt;div style={{ fontWeight: &#39;600&#39;, marginBottom: &#39;4px&#39; }}&gt;

+             &lt;/div&gt;
+             {draggingInfo &amp;&amp; (
+               &lt;&gt;
+                 &lt;div style={{ display: &#39;flex&#39;, justifyContent: &#39;space-between&#39;, gap: &#39;12px&#39; }}&gt;
+                   &lt;span style={{ opacity: 0.8 }}&gt;原止损:&lt;/span&gt;
+                   &lt;span style={{ fontFamily: &#39;monospace&#39; }}&gt;{draggingInfo.originalPrice.toFixed(0)}&lt;/span&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;div style={{ display: &#39;flex&#39;, justifyContent: &#39;space-between&#39;, gap: &#39;12px&#39; }}&gt;
+                   &lt;span style={{ opacity: 0.8 }}&gt;新止损:&lt;/span&gt;
+                   &lt;span style={{ fontFamily: &#39;monospace&#39;, color: &#39;#ffa502&#39; }}&gt;
+                     {draggingInfo.currentPrice.toFixed(0)}
+                   &lt;/span&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+                 {draggingInfo.shadowPrice !== undefined &amp;&amp; (

+                       {draggingInfo.shadowPrice.toFixed(0)}
+                     &lt;/span&gt;
+                   &lt;/div&gt;
+                 )}
+               &lt;/&gt;

+           &lt;/div&gt;
+         )

+ 
+   // nearLine类型使用不同的样式
+   if (type === &#39;nearLine&#39;) {
```

```diff
+ /**
+  * ECharts交易图表组件
+  * 集成了所有交易功能：画线下单、价格线拖拽、自动止损等
+  */
+ import { useEffect, useRef, useState, useCallback, useMemo } from &#39;react&#39;
+ import ReactECharts from &#39;echarts-for-react&#39;
+ import type { EChartsOption, EChartsType } from &#39;echarts&#39;
+ import { Timeframe, ChartKLineData, TradingOrder, PriceLineType, OrderSide } from &#39;../types&#39;
+ import { dataService } from &#39;../services/dataService&#39;
+ import { OrderService } from &#39;../services/orderService&#39;
+ import {
+   createBaseChartOption,
+   createCandlestickSeries,
+   TIMEFRAME_CONFIGS,
+ } from &#39;../utils/chartConfig&#39;
+ import { aggregateTo4Hours } from &#39;../utils/timeframeAggregator&#39;
+ import { createFourHourCandleLineSeriesFromChartData } from &#39;../utils/fourHourCandleRenderer&#39;
+ 
+ // ECharts交易功能
+ import { EChartsPriceLineManager } from &#39;../utils/echartsPriceLineManager&#39;
+ import { EChartsOrderMarkerManager } from &#39;../utils/echartsOrderMarkerManager&#39;
+ import { useEChartsDrawingOrder } from &#39;../hooks/useEChartsDrawingOrder&#39;
+ import { useEChartsPriceLineDrag } from &#39;../hooks/useEChartsPriceLineDrag&#39;
+ import { useEChartsAutoTrailingStopLoss } from &#39;../hooks/useEChartsAutoTrailingStopLoss&#39;
+ import { useEChartsDualStopLoss } from &#39;../hooks/useEChartsDualStopLoss&#39;
+ import { useEChartsEntryLineDrag } from &#39;../hooks/useEChartsEntryLineDrag&#39;
+ import { pixelYToPrice } from &#39;../utils/echartsCrosshairHelper&#39;
+ 
+ // UI组件
+ import CrosshairDataPanel, { CrosshairData } from &#39;./CrosshairDataPanel&#39;
+ import TradingToolbar from &#39;./TradingToolbar&#39;
+ import OrderListPanel from &#39;./OrderListPanel&#39;
+ import StatusIndicator from &#39;./StatusIndicator&#39;
+ import OrderDialog from &#39;./OrderDialog&#39;
+ import &#39;./MultiTimeframeChart.css&#39;
+ 
+ interface EChartsTradingChartProps {
+   timeframes: Timeframe[]
+   height?: string
+   startDate?: string
+   endDate?: string
+ }
+ 
+ // 全局订单服务实例
+ const orderService = new OrderService()
+ 
+ /**
+  * ECharts交易图表组件
+  * 完整集成TradingView的所有交易功能
+  */
+ export default function EChartsTradingChart({
+   timeframes,
+   height = &#39;100%&#39;,
+   startDate,
+   endDate,
+ }: EChartsTradingChartProps) {
+   // 图表状态
+   const [chartOption, setChartOption] = useState&lt;EChartsOption&gt;(createBaseChartOption())
+   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)
+   const [error, setError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null)
+   const chartRef = useRef&lt;ReactECharts&gt;(null)
+   const chartInstanceRef = useRef&lt;EChartsType | null&gt;(null)
+ 
+   // 数据
+   const [oneMinData, setOneMinData] = useState&lt;ChartKLineData[]&gt;([])
+   const [fourHourData, setFourHourData] = useState&lt;ChartKLineData[]&gt;([])
+ 
+   // 交易管理器
+   const [priceLineManager] = useState(() =&gt; new EChartsPriceLineManager())
+   const [markerManager] = useState(() =&gt; new EChartsOrderMarkerManager())
+ 
+   // 订单状态
+   const [pendingOrders, setPendingOrders] = useState&lt;TradingOrder[]&gt;([])
+   const [filledOrders, setFilledOrders] = useState&lt;TradingOrder[]&gt;([])
+ 
+   // 十字光标数据
+   const [crosshairData, setCrosshairData] = useState&lt;CrosshairData | null&gt;(null)
+ 
+   // 鼠标状态
+   const [isNearPriceLine, setIsNearPriceLine] = useState(false)
+ 
+   // 获取ECharts实例
+   const getChartInstance = useCallback((): EChartsType | null =&gt; {
+     if (chartInstanceRef.current) return chartInstanceRef.current
+     if (chartRef.current) {
+       chartInstanceRef.current = chartRef.current.getEchartsInstance()
+       return chartInstanceRef.current
+     }
+     return null
+   }, [])
+ 
+   // 画线下单Hook
+   const {
+     drawingMode,
+     isDrawing,
+     previewPrice,
+     isOrderDialogOpen,
+     pendingOrderPrice,
+     enableDrawingMode,
+     disableDrawingMode,
+     handleCrosshairMove,
+     handleClick: handleDrawingClick,
+     handleEscape,
+     confirmOrder,
+     closeOrderDialog,
+     cancelPendingOrder,
+   } = useEChartsDrawingOrder({
+     priceLineManager,
+     orderService,
+   })
+ 
+   // 价格线拖拽Hook
+   const {
+     isDragging: isPriceLineDragging,
+     draggingLine,
+     findNearestDraggableLine,
+     findNearestOrderLine,
+     startDrag,
+     updateDrag,
+     endDrag,
+     cancelDrag,
+     getCursorStyle,
+   } = useEChartsPriceLineDrag({
+     priceLineManager,
+     chart: getChartInstance(),
+     onPriceChange: (lineId, orderId, newPrice, lineType) =&gt; {
+       console.log(&#39;Price changed:&#39;, { lineId, orderId, newPrice, lineType })
+       // 更新订单
+       if (lineType === PriceLineType.STOP_LOSS) {
+         orderService.updateOrder({ id: orderId, stopLoss: newPrice })
+       } else if (lineType === PriceLineType.TAKE_PROFIT) {
+         orderService.updateOrder({ id: orderId, takeProfit: newPrice })
+       } else if (lineType === PriceLineType.PENDING) {
+         orderService.updateOrder({ id: orderId, price: newPrice })
+       }
+     },
+   })
+ 
+   // 自动追踪止损Hook
+   const {
+     stopLossOffset,
+     autoTrailingEnabled,
+     setStopLossOffset,
+     setAutoTrailingEnabled,
+     updateStopLossOnPendingDrag,
+   } = useEChartsAutoTrailingStopLoss({
+     priceLineManager,
+     orderService,
+     defaultStopLossOffset: 50,
+   })
+ 
+   // 双止损保护Hook
+   const {
+     isDraggingStopLoss,
+     isProtectionActive,
+     originalPrice: dualStopLossOriginalPrice,
+     currentPrice: dualStopLossCurrentPrice,
+     shadowPrice: dualStopLossShadowPrice,
+     startDragStopLoss,
+     updateDragStopLoss,
+     confirmDragStopLoss,
+     cancelDragStopLoss,
+   } = useEChartsDualStopLoss({
+     priceLineManager,
+     lagFactor: 0.3,
+   })
+ 
+   // 从入场线拖拽创建止损/止盈Hook
+   const {
+     isCreatingFromEntry,
+     creatingLineType,
+     entryPrice: creatingEntryPrice,
+     currentPrice: creatingCurrentPrice,
+     findNearestEntryLine,
+     startCreateFromEntry,
+     updateCreateFromEntry,
+     confirmCreateFromEntry,
+     cancelCreateFromEntry,
+   } = useEChartsEntryLineDrag({
+     priceLineManager,
+     orderService,
+     chart: getChartInstance(),
+   })
+ 
+   // 更新订单列表
+   const refreshOrders = useCallback(() =&gt; {
+     setPendingOrders(orderService.getPendingOrders())
+     setFilledOrders(orderService.getFilledOrders())
+   }, [])
+ 
+   // 订阅订单变化
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     orderService.subscribe(refreshOrders)
+     return () =&gt; orderService.unsubscribe(refreshOrders)
+   }, [refreshOrders])
+ 
+   // 加载图表数据
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     loadChartData()
+   }, [timeframes, startDate, endDate])
+ 
+   // 键盘事件处理
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) =&gt; {
+       if (e.key === &#39;Escape&#39;) {
+         handleEscape()
+         if (isPriceLineDragging) cancelDrag()
+         if (isCreatingFromEntry) cancelCreateFromEntry()
+         if (isDraggingStopLoss) cancelDragStopLoss()
+       }
+     }
+ 
+     window.addEventListener(&#39;keydown&#39;, handleKeyDown)
+     return () =&gt; window.removeEventListener(&#39;keydown&#39;, handleKeyDown)
+   }, [handleEscape, isPriceLineDragging, cancelDrag, isCreatingFromEntry, cancelCreateFromEntry, isDraggingStopLoss, cancelDragStopLoss])
+ 
+   // 过滤数据
+   const filterDataByTimeRange = (data: ChartKLineData[]): ChartKLineData[] =&gt; {
+     if (!startDate &amp;&amp; !endDate) return data
+ 
+     const startTimestamp = startDate ? new Date(startDate).getTime() : 0
+     const endTimestamp = endDate ? new Date(endDate).getTime() + 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000 : Infinity
+ 
+     return data.filter(item =&gt; item.timestamp &gt;= startTimestamp &amp;&amp; item.timestamp &lt; endTimestamp)
+   }
+ 
+   // 加载数据
+   const loadChartData = async () =&gt; {
+     try {
+       setLoading(true)
+       setError(null)
+ 
+       dataService.clearCache()
+       const originalLimit = dataService.getDataLimit()
+       dataService.setDataLimit(-1)
+ 
+       const oneMinRawData = await dataService.getData(Timeframe.ONE_MINUTE)
+       dataService.setDataLimit(originalLimit)
+ 
+       const filteredOneMinData = filterDataByTimeRange(oneMinRawData)
+       const calculated4HourData = aggregateTo4Hours(filteredOneMinData)
+ 
+       setOneMinData(filteredOneMinData)
+       setFourHourData(calculated4HourData)
+ 
+       console.log(&#96;📊 Loaded ${filteredOneMinData.length} 1-min, ${calculated4HourData.length} 4-hour candles&#96;)
+ 
+       // 创建series
+       const series: EChartsOption[&#39;series&#39;] = []
+       const dataMap = new Map&lt;Timeframe, ChartKLineData[]&gt;()
+       dataMap.set(Timeframe.ONE_MINUTE, filteredOneMinData)
+       dataMap.set(Timeframe.FOUR_HOURS, calculated4HourData)
+ 
+       timeframes.forEach((timeframe) =&gt; {
+         const data = dataMap.get(timeframe)
+         if (!data || data.length === 0) return
+ 
+         const config = TIMEFRAME_CONFIGS[timeframe]
+ 
+         if (timeframe === Timeframe.FOUR_HOURS) {
+           const lineSeriesConfig = createFourHourCandleLineSeriesFromChartData(
+             getTimeframeName(timeframe),
+             data,
+             config
+           )
+           series.push(lineSeriesConfig)
+           return
+         }
+ 
+         let sampledData = data
+         if (timeframe === Timeframe.ONE_MINUTE &amp;&amp; data.length &gt; 2000) {
+           const step = Math.ceil(data.length / 2000)
+           sampledData = data.filter((_, index) =&gt; index % step === 0)
+         }
+ 
+         const chartData: [number, number, number, number, number][] = sampledData.map((item) =&gt; [
+           item.timestamp,
+           item.open,
+           item.high,
+           item.low,
+           item.close,
+         ])
+ 
+         const seriesConfig = createCandlestickSeries(getTimeframeName(timeframe), chartData, config)
+         series.push(seriesConfig)
+       })
+ 
+       const newOption: EChartsOption = {
+         ...createBaseChartOption(),
+         legend: {
+           data: timeframes.map(getTimeframeName),
+           textStyle: { color: &#39;#ffffff&#39; },
+           top: 10,
+           right: 50,
+         },
+         series,
+       }
+ 
+       setChartOption(newOption)
+       setLoading(false)
+     } catch (err) {
+       console.error(&#39;Error loading chart data:&#39;, err)
+       setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : &#39;Failed to load chart data&#39;)
+       setLoading(false)
+     }
+   }
+ 
+   const getTimeframeName = (timeframe: Timeframe): string =&gt; {
+     const names: Record&lt;Timeframe, string&gt; = {
+       [Timeframe.ONE_MINUTE]: &#39;1分钟&#39;,
+       [Timeframe.FIVE_MINUTES]: &#39;5分钟&#39;,
+       [Timeframe.ONE_HOUR]: &#39;1小时&#39;,
+       [Timeframe.FOUR_HOURS]: &#39;4小时&#39;,
+       [Timeframe.ONE_DAY]: &#39;日线&#39;,
+     }
+     return names[timeframe]
+   }
+ 
+   // 图表事件处理
+   const onChartReady = useCallback((chart: EChartsType) =&gt; {
+     chartInstanceRef.current = chart
+     priceLineManager.setChart(chart)
+   }, [priceLineManager])
+ 
+   const onChartEvents = useMemo(() =&gt; ({
+     mousemove: (params: any) =&gt; {
+       const chart = getChartInstance()
+       if (!chart) return
+ 
+       const pixelY = params.event?.offsetY
+       if (pixelY === undefined) return
+ 
+       const price = pixelYToPrice(chart, pixelY)
+       
+       // 更新十字光标数据
+       if (params.data) {
+         const [timestamp, open, high, low, close] = params.data
+         const prevClose = open // 简化：使用开盘价作为前收
+         setCrosshairData({
+           time: new Date(timestamp).toLocaleString(&#39;zh-CN&#39;),
+           open,
+           high,
+           low,
+           close,
+           volume: 0,
+           change: close - prevClose,
+           changePercent: ((close - prevClose) / prevClose) * 100,
+         })
+       }
+ 
+       // 画线模式处理
+       if (isDrawing &amp;&amp; price !== null) {
+         handleCrosshairMove(price)
+       }
+ 
+       // 拖拽处理
+       if (isPriceLineDragging) {
+         updateDrag(pixelY)
+       }
+ 
+       // 双止损拖拽
+       if (isDraggingStopLoss &amp;&amp; price !== null) {
+         updateDragStopLoss(price)
+       }
+ 
+       // 创建止损/止盈
+       if (isCreatingFromEntry) {
+         updateCreateFromEntry(pixelY)
+       }
+ 
+       // 检测是否靠近价格线
+       if (!isDrawing &amp;&amp; !isPriceLineDragging &amp;&amp; !isCreatingFromEntry) {
+         const nearLine = findNearestDraggableLine(pixelY)
+         setIsNearPriceLine(!!nearLine)
+       }
+     },
+     click: () =&gt; {
+       if (isDrawing) {
+         handleDrawingClick()
+       }
+     },
+     mousedown: (params: any) =&gt; {
+       const chart = getChartInstance()
+       if (!chart || isDrawing) return
+ 
+       const pixelY = params.event?.offsetY
+       if (pixelY === undefined) return
+ 
+       // 检查是否点击了可拖拽的线
+       const draggableLine = findNearestDraggableLine(pixelY)
+       if (draggableLine) {
+         if (draggableLine.type === PriceLineType.STOP_LOSS) {
+           // 止损线使用双止损保护
+           const order = orderService.getOrder(draggableLine.orderId || &#39;&#39;)
+           if (order) {
+             startDragStopLoss(draggableLine, order.side)
+           }
+         } else {
+           startDrag(draggableLine)
+         }
+         return
+       }
+ 
+       // 检查是否点击了入场线
+       const entryLine = findNearestEntryLine(pixelY)
+       if (entryLine) {
+         startCreateFromEntry(entryLine, pixelY)
+       }
+     },
+     mouseup: () =&gt; {
+       if (isPriceLineDragging) {
+         endDrag()
+       }
+       if (isDraggingStopLoss) {
+         confirmDragStopLoss()
+       }
+       if (isCreatingFromEntry) {
+         confirmCreateFromEntry()
+       }
+     },
+     globalout: () =&gt; {
+       setCrosshairData(null)
+     },
+   }), [
+     getChartInstance,
+     isDrawing,
+     handleCrosshairMove,
+     handleDrawingClick,
+     isPriceLineDragging,
+     updateDrag,
+     endDrag,
+     isDraggingStopLoss,
+     updateDragStopLoss,
+     confirmDragStopLoss,
+     isCreatingFromEntry,
+     updateCreateFromEntry,
+     confirmCreateFromEntry,
+     findNearestDraggableLine,
+     findNearestEntryLine,
+     startDrag,
+     startDragStopLoss,
+     startCreateFromEntry,
+   ])
+ 
+   // 模拟成交
+   const simulateFillOrder = useCallback((orderId: string) =&gt; {
+     const order = orderService.getOrder(orderId)
+     if (!order) return
+ 
+     orderService.fillOrder(orderId, order.price)
+ 
+     // 更新价格线
+     const orderLines = priceLineManager.getLinesByOrderId(orderId)
+     const pendingLine = orderLines.find(l =&gt; l.type === PriceLineType.PENDING)
+     if (pendingLine) {
+       priceLineManager.removeLine(pendingLine.id)
+       priceLineManager.createEntryLine({
+         orderId,
+         price: order.price,
+         side: order.side,
+         quantity: order.quantity,
+       })
+     }
+ 
+     // 添加成交标记
+     const filledOrder = orderService.getOrder(orderId)
+     if (filledOrder) {
+       markerManager.addFilledOrderMarker(filledOrder)
+     }
+   }, [priceLineManager, markerManager])
+ 
+   // 图例项
+   const legendItems = useMemo(() =&gt; [
+     { color: &#39;#ff4757&#39;, label: &#39;1分钟&#39; },
+     { color: &#39;#4a9eff&#39;, label: &#39;4小时&#39; },
+   ], [])
+ 
+   // 鼠标样式
+   const cursorStyle = getCursorStyle(isNearPriceLine, isPriceLineDragging || isDraggingStopLoss)
+ 
+   if (loading) {
+     return (
+       &lt;div className=&quot;chart-loading&quot;&gt;
+         &lt;div className=&quot;loading-spinner&quot;&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
+         &lt;p&gt;Loading chart data...&lt;/p&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+     )
+   }
+ 
+   if (error) {
+     return (
+       &lt;div className=&quot;chart-error&quot;&gt;
+         &lt;p&gt;⚠️ Error loading chart&lt;/p&gt;
+         &lt;p className=&quot;error-message&quot;&gt;{error}&lt;/p&gt;
+         &lt;button onClick={loadChartData}&gt;Retry&lt;/button&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+     )
+   }
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;div className=&quot;multi-timeframe-chart&quot; style={{ cursor: cursorStyle }}&gt;
+       &lt;ReactECharts
+         ref={chartRef}
+         option={chartOption}
+         style={{ height, width: &#39;100%&#39; }}
+         notMerge={true}
+         lazyUpdate={true}
+         opts={{ renderer: &#39;canvas&#39; }}
+         onChartReady={onChartReady}
+         onEvents={onChartEvents}
+       /&gt;
+ 
+       {/* K线数据面板 */}
+       &lt;CrosshairDataPanel
+         data={crosshairData}
+         showLegend={true}
+         legendItems={legendItems}
+       /&gt;
+ 
+       {/* 工具栏 */}
+       &lt;TradingToolbar
+         drawingMode={drawingMode}
+         isDrawing={isDrawing}
+         onEnableDrawingMode={enableDrawingMode}
+         onDisableDrawingMode={disableDrawingMode}
+         autoTrailingEnabled={autoTrailingEnabled}
+         stopLossOffset={stopLossOffset}
+         onSetAutoTrailingEnabled={setAutoTrailingEnabled}
+         onSetStopLossOffset={setStopLossOffset}
+       /&gt;
+ 
+       {/* 订单列表 */}
+       &lt;OrderListPanel
+         orders={[...pendingOrders, ...filledOrders]}
+         onSimulateFill={simulateFillOrder}
+         onCancelOrder={cancelPendingOrder}
+       /&gt;
+ 
+       {/* 状态提示 */}
+       &lt;StatusIndicator
+         type=&quot;drawing&quot;
+         visible={isDrawing}
+         drawingPrice={previewPrice || undefined}
+       /&gt;
+ 
+       &lt;StatusIndicator
+         type=&quot;dragging&quot;
+         visible={isPriceLineDragging &amp;&amp; !isDraggingStopLoss}
+         draggingInfo={draggingLine ? {
+           originalPrice: draggingLine.price,
+           currentPrice: draggingLine.price,
+         } : undefined}
+       /&gt;
+ 
+       &lt;StatusIndicator
+         type=&quot;dualStopLoss&quot;
+         visible={isDraggingStopLoss &amp;&amp; isProtectionActive}
+         draggingInfo={dualStopLossOriginalPrice !== null ? {
+           originalPrice: dualStopLossOriginalPrice,
+           currentPrice: dualStopLossCurrentPrice || dualStopLossOriginalPrice,
+           shadowPrice: dualStopLossShadowPrice || undefined,
+         } : undefined}
+       /&gt;
+ 
+       &lt;StatusIndicator
+         type=&quot;creating&quot;
+         visible={isCreatingFromEntry}
+         creatingInfo={creatingEntryPrice !== null &amp;&amp; creatingCurrentPrice !== null ? {
+           lineType: creatingLineType || &#39;stop_loss&#39;,
+           entryPrice: creatingEntryPrice,
+           currentPrice: creatingCurrentPrice,
+         } : undefined}
+       /&gt;
+ 
+       &lt;StatusIndicator
+         type=&quot;nearLine&quot;
+         visible={!isDrawing &amp;&amp; !isPriceLineDragging &amp;&amp; !isCreatingFromEntry &amp;&amp; isNearPriceLine}
+       /&gt;
+ 
+       {/* 下单对话框 */}
+       &lt;OrderDialog
+         isOpen={isOrderDialogOpen}
+         price={pendingOrderPrice || 0}
+         onConfirm={confirmOrder}
+         onCancel={closeOrderDialog}
+       /&gt;
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   )
+ }
+
```

```diff
+   describe(&#39;订单服务订阅机制&#39;, () =&gt; {
+     it(&#39;订单变化时通知订阅者&#39;, () =&gt; {
+       const callback = vi.fn()
+       orderService.subscribe(callback)
+ 
+       // 创建订单
+       const order = orderService.createOrder({
+         side: OrderSide.BUY,
+         price: 25000,
+         quantity: 1,
+       })
+       expect(callback).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
+ 
+       // 成交订单
+       orderService.fillOrder(order.id, 25000)
+       expect(callback).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2)
+ 
+       // 取消订阅
+       orderService.unsubscribe(callback)
+ 
+       // 再次操作不应触发回调
+       orderService.createOrder({
+         side: OrderSide.SELL,
+         price: 25100,
+         quantity: 1,
+       })
+       expect(callback).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2) // 仍然是2次
+     })
+   })
+ 
+   describe(&#39;ECharts配置生成&#39;, () =&gt; {
+     it(&#39;价格线转换为markLine配置&#39;, () =&gt; {
+       priceLineManager.createPendingLine({
+         orderId: &#39;test-order&#39;,
+         price: 25000,
+         side: OrderSide.BUY,
+         quantity: 1,
+       })
+ 
+       priceLineManager.createStopLossLine({
+         orderId: &#39;test-order&#39;,
+         price: 24900,
+         side: OrderSide.BUY,
+       })
+ 
+       const markLineOption = priceLineManager.toEChartsMarkLineOption()
+ 
+       expect(markLineOption.data).toHaveLength(2)
+       expect(markLineOption.silent).toBe(false)
+     })
+ 
+     it(&#39;订单标记转换为markPoint配置&#39;, () =&gt; {
+       const order = orderService.createOrder({
+         side: OrderSide.BUY,
+         price: 25000,
+         quantity: 1,
+       })
+       orderService.fillOrder(order.id, 25000)
+ 
+       const filledOrder = orderService.getOrder(order.id)
+       markerManager.addFilledOrderMarker(filledOrder!)
+ 
+       const markPointOption = markerManager.toEChartsMarkPointOption()
+ 
+       expect(markPointOption.data).toHaveLength(1)
+       expect(markPointOption.silent).toBe(true)
+       expect(markPointOption.animation).toBe(true)
+     })
+   })
+ 
+   describe(&#39;边界情况&#39;, () =&gt; {
+     it(&#39;空数据处理&#39;, () =&gt; {
+       expect(priceLineManager.getAllLines()).toHaveLength(0)
+       expect(priceLineManager.toEChartsMarkLineOption().data).toHaveLength(0)
+ 
+       expect(markerManager.getAllMarkers()).toHaveLength(0)
+       expect(markerManager.toEChartsMarkPointOption().data).toHaveLength(0)
+     })
+ 
+     it(&#39;无效订单ID处理&#39;, () =&gt; {
+       const result = priceLineManager.removeLinesByOrderId(&#39;non-existent-id&#39;)
+       expect(result).toBe(0)
+ 
+       const lines = priceLineManager.getLinesByOrderId(&#39;non-existent-id&#39;)
+       expect(lines).toHaveLength(0)
+     })
+ 
+     it(&#39;重复移除处理&#39;, () =&gt; {
+       const line = priceLineManager.createPendingLine({
+         orderId: &#39;test&#39;,
+         price: 25000,
+         side: OrderSide.BUY,
+         quantity: 1,
+       })
+ 
+       const result1 = priceLineManager.removeLine(line.id)
+       expect(result1).toBe(true)
+ 
+       const result2 = priceLineManager.removeLine(line.id)
+       expect(result2).toBe(false) // 已经移除了
+     })
+   })
+ })
+
```

```tsx
import EChartsTradingChart from './components/EChartsTradingChart'

  timeframes={[Timeframe.FOUR_HOURS, Timeframe.ONE_MINUTE]} 
/>
```

```diff
+ 
+ /**
+  * 创建适用于category轴的4小时K线画线系列配置
+  * 使用索引而不是时间戳来定位X坐标
+  * 
+  * @param name 系列名称
+  * @param data 4小时K线数据数组
+  * @param config 时间周期配置
+  * @param timestampToIndex 时间戳到索引的映射
+  * @returns ECharts custom series 配置
+  */
+ export function createFourHourCandleLineSeriesForCategoryAxis(
+   name: string,
+   data: FourHourCandleData[],
+   config: TimeframeConfig,
+   timestampToIndex: Map&lt;number, number&gt;
+ ): CustomSeriesOption {
+   // 转换为 ECharts custom series 需要的数据格式
+   // 对于category轴，使用索引而不是时间戳
+   // [startIndex, endIndex, open, high, low, close, midIndex]
+   const seriesData = data.map(item =&gt; {
+     // 查找最接近的索引
+     const startIndex = findClosestIndex(item.startTimestamp, timestampToIndex)
+     const endIndex = findClosestIndex(item.endTimestamp, timestampToIndex)
+     const midIndex = item.midpointTimestamp 
+       ? findClosestIndex(item.midpointTimestamp, timestampToIndex)
+       : Math.floor((startIndex + endIndex) / 2)
+     
+     return [
+       startIndex,
+       endIndex,
+       item.open,
+       item.high,
+       item.low,
+       item.close,
+       midIndex,
+     ]
+   }).filter(item =&gt; item[0] &gt;= 0 &amp;&amp; item[1] &gt;= 0) // 过滤掉无法定位的数据
+ 
+   return {
+     name,
+     type: &#39;custom&#39;,
+     renderItem: fourHourCandleRenderItemForCategory,
+     encode: {
+       x: [0, 1],  // 使用 startIndex 和 endIndex 作为 x 轴范围
+       y: [2, 3, 4, 5],  // 使用 open, high, low, close 作为 y 轴范围
+     },
+     data: seriesData,
+     z: config.zIndex,
+     clip: true,
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * 查找最接近的索引
+  */
+ function findClosestIndex(timestamp: number, timestampToIndex: Map&lt;number, number&gt;): number {
+   // 精确匹配
+   if (timestampToIndex.has(timestamp)) {
+     return timestampToIndex.get(timestamp)!
+   }
+   
+   // 查找最接近的时间戳
+   let closestTimestamp = -1
+   let closestDistance = Infinity
+   
+   for (const [ts] of timestampToIndex) {
+     const distance = Math.abs(ts - timestamp)
+     if (distance &lt; closestDistance) {
+       closestDistance = distance
+       closestTimestamp = ts
+     }
+   }
+   
+   return closestTimestamp &gt;= 0 ? timestampToIndex.get(closestTimestamp)! : -1
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * 4小时K线画线渲染函数 (category轴版本)
+  * 使用索引而不是时间戳
+  */
+ export const fourHourCandleRenderItemForCategory: CustomSeriesRenderItem = (params, api) =&gt; {
+   // 获取数据值 (索引)
+   const startIndex = api.value(0) as number
+   const endIndex = api.value(1) as number
+   const open = api.value(2) as number
+   const high = api.value(3) as number
+   const low = api.value(4) as number
+   const close = api.value(5) as number
+   const midIndex = api.value(6) as number
+ 
+   // 判断涨跌
+   const isBullish = close &gt;= open
+   const color = getCandleColor(isBullish)
+ 
+   // 计算实体的上下边界
+   const bodyTop = Math.max(open, close)
+   const bodyBottom = Math.min(open, close)
+ 
+   // 转换为像素坐标 (category轴使用索引)
+   const startPoint = api.coord([startIndex, 0])
+   const endPoint = api.coord([endIndex, 0])
+ 
+   // 获取X坐标
+   const x1 = startPoint[0]  // 起始索引X坐标
+   const x2 = endPoint[0]    // 结束索引X坐标
+   
+   // 计算影线X坐标：使用中点索引
+   const midPoint = api.coord([midIndex, 0])
+   const midX = midPoint[0]
+ 
+   // 获取Y坐标
+   const yTop = api.coord([0, bodyTop])[1]
+   const yBottom = api.coord([0, bodyBottom])[1]
+   const yHigh = api.coord([0, high])[1]
+   const yLow = api.coord([0, low])[1]
+ 
+   // 线宽配置
+   const lineWidth = 2
+ 
+   // 创建绘制元素组
+   const children: any[] = []
+ 
+   // 1. 实体顶部水平线 (从 x1 到 x2)
+   children.push({
+     type: &#39;line&#39;,
+     shape: { x1: x1, y1: yTop, x2: x2, y2: yTop },
+     style: { stroke: color, lineWidth: lineWidth },
+   })
+ 
+   // 2. 实体底部水平线 (从 x1 到 x2)
+   children.push({
+     type: &#39;line&#39;,
+     shape: { x1: x1, y1: yBottom, x2: x2, y2: yBottom },
+     style: { stroke: color, lineWidth: lineWidth },
+   })
+ 
+   // 3. 左侧竖线 (在起始位置，连接顶部和底部)
+   children.push({
+     type: &#39;line&#39;,
+     shape: { x1: x1, y1: yTop, x2: x1, y2: yBottom },
+     style: { stroke: color, lineWidth: lineWidth },
+   })
+ 
+   // 4. 右侧竖线 (在结束位置，连接顶部和底部)
+   children.push({
+     type: &#39;line&#39;,
+     shape: { x1: x2, y1: yTop, x2: x2, y2: yBottom },
+     style: { stroke: color, lineWidth: lineWidth },
+   })
+ 
+   // 5. 上影线 (从实体顶部到最高价，在中点位置)
+   if (high &gt; bodyTop) {
+     children.push({
+       type: &#39;line&#39;,
+       shape: { x1: midX, y1: yTop, x2: midX, y2: yHigh },
+       style: { stroke: color, lineWidth: lineWidth },
+     })
+   }
+ 
+   // 6. 下影线 (从实体底部到最低价，在中点位置)
+   if (low &lt; bodyBottom) {
+     children.push({
+       type: &#39;line&#39;,
+       shape: { x1: midX, y1: yBottom, x2: midX, y2: yLow },
+       style: { stroke: color, lineWidth: lineWidth },
+     })
+   }
+ 
+   return {
+     type: &#39;group&#39;,
+     children,
+   }
+ }
  
  
```

```diff
+   const checkShadowStopLossBreached = useCallback((marketPrice: number): boolean =&gt; {
```

✅ 已添加影子止损突破平仓功能！

**功能说明：**
1. **突破检测逻辑**：
   - 多单：市场价 ≤ 影子止损价 → 触发平仓
   - 空单：市场价 ≥ 影子止损价 → 触发平仓

2. **自动操作**：
   - 突破时自动调用平仓
   - 显示alert提示用户
   - 清理拖拽状态和影子线

3. **检测时机**：
   - 当拖拽止损线时，实时监控最新K线收盘价
   - 数据更新时自动检测

请刷新页面测试。注意：由于是历史数据，价格不会实时变化。在实盘或模拟盘中，当新K线价格突破影子止损时会触发平仓。
